pages.title: Orientation
lines: PenTrace is a breach sim: recon hosts, crack services, finish contracts, jack out before SOC traces you.
help [n] pages unlock in the same order Vex teaches. help with no number shows the index.
hint gives the next safe command. GUIDE (top bar) mirrors training steps.
index opens concept cards tied to real tools (port scan, SSH abuse, firewalls).

pages.title: Files & shell
lines: ls  cd  pwd  cat  head  tail  grep  sort  uniq  wc
rm removes files. Glob patterns work where the parser supports them (see help 8).
TAB completes filenames. History: ↑ and ↓.
Pipes: cmd | cmd  (e.g. cat notes.txt | grep scope).

pages.title: Network & pivot
lines: scan from a host you own to discover neighbors.
nmap -sV <ip> fingerprints open services (required for edge survey jobs).
connect <ip> attaches your shell to a host. dc disconnects.
scp <remote-path> pulls files to ~/downloads on your rig when you have access.

pages.title: Breach tools
lines: sshbrute <ip>  — SSH password spray (noisy; watch TRACE).
webscan <ip>   — HTTP weakness check on port 80.
ftploot <ip>   — shop tool; anonymous FTP (quieter).
getroot <ip>   — privilege escalation after enough ports are open.
man <tool> for usage. tools lists what you own.

pages.title: Firewalls
lines: fwrules <ip> shows iptables-style rules (adds a little heat).
Rules match top-down. Look for ACCEPT lines that name a trusted source.
fwbypass <ip> --src <pivot-ip> spoofs that source after you identify it.
You cannot crack through a live firewall until bypass succeeds.

pages.title: Jobs & mail
lines: jobs lists the contract board. mail reads fixer briefings.
submit <job-id> <answer> when the objective needs an explicit answer (e.g. c3 IOC IP).
Recon jobs complete when objectives are met in the world (c1: all hosts fingerprinted).
jackout ends the run (stealth bonus if trace stayed low).

pages.title: Meta progression
lines: contacts shows fixer Standing (this op) and Trust Floor (meta).
perks spends Operator Rank points (timedrive, ram_overclock, …).
shop / buy <item> — permanent rig upgrades.
hints [off|nudge|training|auto] — tutorial nudges (default auto: Nudge until Rank 5).

pages.title: PenTrace terminal rules
lines: Fiction contract: this is a game shell, not bash — but rules are consistent everywhere.
Supported: pipes (|), quoted arguments, common file verbs, game breach commands.
Wildcards: rm /var/log/* style globs; grep uses patterns you type literally.
Not supported: recursive rm flags, curl/wget, arbitrary scripting (Workshop later).
When unsure: man <tool>, index, or help [n].
